content:
Dylan Brooks: quick thread on checklist persistence + reset behavior + admin override. want to lock this down before we ship beta broadly.

Dylan Brooks: current implementation in PR-48226 stores server-side state per org+project (not client localStorage). question is: what exactly are our reset semantics + who can do it.

Chloe Martin: yep. backend has `checklist_states` keyed by org_id + project_id + checklist_id (right now just `hosted_api_onboarding_v1`). steps stored as a map-ish blob in DB + computed validations update it.

Jada Williams: reminder: ADR-0137 says source-of-truth server-side, client caches for render only. state update via PATCH endpoint. we also have validator jobs (first success, streaming) that may flip steps async.

Hannah Rivera: on the Console side, we currently treat server response as authoritative. when user clicks “Mark as done” for manual steps, we PATCH just that step.

Dev Patel: from Support POV: we need a safe way to reset for (a) debugging, (b) customer accidentally “completed” something (less common), and (c) beta issues where step got stuck.

Priya Shah: +1, we already had INT-3309 about needing to reset in beta. right now we’re telling folks to ignore the UI which is not great.

Dylan Brooks: ok let’s define reset types:
1) reset entire checklist for a project
2) reset a single step
3) “recompute” from validators (i.e., don’t manually set, just re-run)

Chloe Martin: (3) is basically “clear step + let validators re-mark when signals show up”. we can implement as reset-to-incomplete and validators will eventually fill.

Nadia Rahman: careful: if we clear server state, we should also emit telemetry so analytics doesn’t look like user regressed organically. funnel charts will get weird.

Logan Wright: +1. we should emit an explicit event like `onboarding_checklist_reset` with `reset_scope` and `actor_type` (support/admin/user). also needs to be allowlisted + no PII.

Jada Williams: we also need to think about race conditions: validators may be running while reset happens. simplest: reset increments a `state_version` and validators include `expected_version` when patching. if mismatch, validator retries after reading latest.

Hannah Rivera: frontend would also need to handle “state changed” (version bumped) and re-fetch. right now we already revalidate on focus; can add a 409 handler -> GET latest.

Dylan Brooks: permissions: do we let customer org admins reset themselves? or support only?

Dev Patel: strong preference: customers should NOT be able to reset in beta. it’ll generate tickets and weirdness (“why did it reset?”). also opens door to gaming completion metrics.

Priya Shah: agree. keep it internal. when GA maybe we add “Restart onboarding” but that’s a product decision.

Chloe Martin: implementation-wise, internal-only endpoint is easiest. we can gate via `X-Redwood-Admin` (internal auth) or separate admin service token. Console shouldn’t expose it.

Kaitlyn Nguyen: for API key steps: if we reset “prod key created”, but key still exists, validator will immediately re-mark complete. that’s fine but might surprise support.

Jada Williams: maybe reset reason is “force UI to replay / unstick” not “delete evidence”. we should document that reset is not a wipe of reality.

Dylan Brooks: exactly. reset is only “clear our onboarding progress state”, not delete keys / usage / logs.

Leila Farouk: QA question: will E2E tests need reset? we want deterministic runs.

Chloe Martin: yes. we can add an admin-only reset for test env, plus in prod we have the support tool. for E2E we can use the admin override in staging.

Leila Farouk: ok as long as it’s stable and doesn’t require manual DB cleanup.

Nadia Rahman: telemetry detail: emit reset event *once* per reset call, not per step. include `checklist_id`, `project_id_hash` (not raw), `reset_scope` (all vs step), `step_id` if applicable, `reason_code` (enum), and `actor_type`.

Logan Wright: and ensure it’s not sampled out. resets are rare but important. also route to the privacy allowlist pipeline.

Jada Williams: about “step reset” vs “full reset”: do we really need step-level reset? support could just full reset.

Priya Shah: step-level is helpful when only 1 step is bugged and we don’t want to confuse user by clearing everything else.

Dev Patel: agree. also for troubleshooting, it’s useful to isolate a single validator.

Chloe Martin: ok step-level reset it is.

Hannah Rivera: UI question: if support resets, user is mid-page. do they see it live?

Hannah Rivera: we can add SSE or just refresh on next nav. simplest: on page load + every X minutes poll? (pls no)

Dylan Brooks: no polling. ok to show next time they open Console / revisit page. this is admin ops, not user action.

Jada Williams: agree. plus reset is usually while user is in a support call; support can ask them to refresh.

ChecklistBot: Dylan Brooks added a reminder: “Define reset semantics + permissions for checklist state” (in 2 days)

Chloe Martin: audit logging: if internal action changes customer-facing state, we should write an audit row.

Chloe Martin: minimally: org_id, project_id, checklist_id, actor (support user id or service), action, scope, reason, timestamp.

Dylan Brooks: where does that live? existing audit log system or in checklist DB table?

Jada Williams: better to use existing audit log infra if available. if not, we can add `checklist_state_history` table (append-only) but that’s more work.

Kaitlyn Nguyen: security will ask for “who did it” + “why”. if we can’t plumb into centralized audit log quickly, at least write a row in DB and expose in internal admin UI.

Nadia Rahman: note: don’t send reason freeform into telemetry. keep it as enum. but DB audit reason can be freeform if needed.

Dev Patel: proposed reason enums (support macro-friendly): `stuck_validation`, `incorrect_completion`, `demo_reset`, `test_env_cleanup`, `other`.

Priya Shah: + `telemetry_debug` maybe.

Logan Wright: fine.

Chloe Martin: API proposal:
- POST `/internal/onboarding/checklists/:checklist_id/reset`
body: `org_id`, `project_id`, `scope=all|step`, `step_id?`, `reason_code`, `reason_note?`
returns updated state

Jada Williams: + require internal auth. rate limit hard. and write audit entry.

Hannah Rivera: do we need a customer-visible endpoint at all? (no)

Dylan Brooks: no. Console shouldn’t call it. internal tool only.

Leila Farouk: for tests, can we call it from Cypress as “internal”? we can wire staging test credentials.

Chloe Martin: yep. just keep it blocked from prod unless test runner is on allowlist.

Jada Williams: also, about persistence: we decided per project not per org, right?

Dylan Brooks: yes. onboarding is about getting a project to first success + prod launch. org-level feels wrong (multi-project orgs).

Dev Patel: + support tickets are usually per project anyway.

Kaitlyn Nguyen: edge case: if user deletes project and recreates with same name, state should be new. since key is project_id, we’re good.

Nadia Rahman: telemetry identity: make sure project_id is hashed at emit time (or use internal surrogate) per privacy review.

Logan Wright: we already do `project_public_id` in some events. but security asked we treat it as pseudonymous and still allowlist. let’s be consistent.

Chloe Martin: last thing: what about “reset should also clear dedupe keys” for step events?

Nadia Rahman: no, dedupe keys are per event emission, not per state. if you reset and then user completes again, those events should emit again with new `event_id`. that’s correct.

Jada Williams: ok.

Dylan Brooks: action items:
- Chloe/Jada: spec internal reset endpoint + audit log approach (link in ENG ticket)
- Nadia/Logan: define `onboarding_checklist_reset` event props + allowlist
- Priya/Dev: confirm reason_code enum list
- Hannah: note in Console runbook: “if support resets, ask customer to refresh”

Dylan Brooks: dropping this into ENG-23119/ENG-23112 follow-ups. :thumbsup:

Priya Shah: :thumbsup: thanks. this will save us a ton of back-and-forth during beta.

Dev Patel: +1. once we have it, Support can write a macro + escalation steps.

Chloe Martin: I’ll draft the endpoint + DB audit row today and ping security once we have a concrete proposal.

Jada Williams: I’ll add the state_version bump + validator conflict handling notes to ADR comment thread.

Nadia Rahman: will draft event schema snippet and send for review.

Logan Wright: also adding dashboard annotation so resets don’t look like drop-off.

Dylan Brooks: perfect. closing loop here once we have the PR up.
